description_en: This three-bay Phalcāhas been built in a traditional Newar style and is attached to S. Avāle's house. Two stone images of two couples are attached to the wall of the house. Tuyuṣā and his wife Nhasalā are depicted on one stone slate whilst Bhim and his wife Latimāyā can be seen in another. Both couples are the ancestors of S. Avāle; this can be gleaned from the inscription has been placed below the statues. Two paintings, one of a cat and one of an elephant are located on the rear wall of the Phalcā.The monumentcollapsed in the 2015 earthquakes and was reconstructed in 2018.
description_ne: तीन वटा कवल भएको यो फल्चा परम्परागत नेवार शैलीमा बनाइएको छ । फल्चामा यसका दाता तुयुषा र उनकी पत्नी न्हसला, अनि भिम र उनकी पत्नी लतिमायाको दुई फिट अग्ला प्रतिमा राखिएको छ उनीहरू फल्चासँगै जोडिएको घर भएका श्याम अवालेका पूर्वज थिए । फल्चाको पछाडि भित्तामा बिरालो र हात्तीका चित्र बनाइएको छ । सन् २०१५ को भूकम्पमा ध्वस्त भएको यो फल्चा २०१८ मा पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो ।
monument_assessment: Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired), Rebuilt

historical_events.event_description: Tuyuṣā Nhasalā and Bhim Latimāyā established this Phalcā in NS 927 (1807 CE).
The Lalitpur Municipality reconstructed the Phalcā.
